name: Print Management with Biblio Dispatch
author: invoked

sections.description:
The Biblio Dispatch plugin integrates with WooCommerce to automate the process of sending order details to a delivery service API. Upon configuration, user will be registered to authorsuite dashboard and listens for every new order placement. When an order is placed, the order details are automatically sent to a delivery service URL. Orders payments can be made with authorsuite dashboard as well.

Additionally, the plugin provides a simple registration and login system that integrates with a dashboard, allowing users to manage their delivery information and track their orders.

✨ Key Features

• Automated Order Processing
Instantly transfers WooCommerce order details to the BiblioDispatch system, eliminating manual intervention and reducing errors.

• Author Suite Dashboard Integration
Provides a centralized platform for managing delivery details, tracking orders, and processing payments, enhancing operational efficiency.

• Real-Time Order Tracking
Empowers customers to monitor their order status from printing to delivery, fostering transparency and trust.

• Customizable Notifications
Delivers automated email updates to customers at each fulfillment stage, keeping them informed and engaged.

• Secure Payment Handling
Ensures all financial transactions are protected through the Author Suite dashboard, maintaining customer confidence.

🌟 Benefits

• Efficiency
Automates the entire order fulfillment process, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

• Accuracy
Reduces the risk of errors associated with manual order handling, ensuring customer satisfaction.

• User-Friendly Interface
Offers an intuitive dashboard for both store owners and customers to manage and track orders effortlessly.

• Scalability
Designed to handle increasing order volumes, making it suitable for businesses of all sizes.

• Enhanced Customer Experience
Provides real-time tracking and updates, improving customer trust and loyalty.

⚙️ Installation

• Install and Activate
Install the BiblioDispatch WP Plugin through the WordPress Plugin Directory.

• Configure Settings
Set up the plugin to connect your WooCommerce store with the BiblioDispatch system.

• Manage Your Orders
Use the Author Suite dashboard to manage orders, track fulfillment, and monitor success.

For support you may write your concerns on support@glassonionglobal.com

= What if i dont have consumer key and consumer secret

Navigate to the Woocommerce advanced setting’s Rest Api section, where you can generate the consumer key and consumer secret.

Do i need to configure Webhook?

No, webhooks will be automatically generated while clicks on save button of plugin or while access portal.

A brief Markdown Example

Biblio Dispatch automatically sends WooCommerce order details to a delivery API via webhook.

Ordered list of features:

  1. Webhook creation on configuration.
  2. Automatic order sending to service.
  3. Dashboard login and registration.
  4. Provides print fulfilment services for your orders

📞 Support

Need Help?
Visit our support page or contact our dedicated team for assistance.

Experience seamless order fulfillment today—get the BiblioDispatch WP Plugin now!
